checks.name: static RTL review
checks.details: Exact benchmark interface; four continuous one-hot transition equations and Moore output; no storage, latches, or clock/reset ports.

checks.name: Independent self-checking development simulation
checks.details: All eight legal one-hot state/input combinations checked against the supplied transition table, including Moore output.

development_outcome: Initial candidate passed development checks without RTL revisions. candidate_initial.sv was preserved before checks. Ports use one-bit input/output and four-bit state vectors; outputs are combinational with no pipeline.
limitations: Development simulation covers legal one-hot states; invalid encodings and unknown values were not tested.
No synthesis, Vivado timing/resource evidence, or board validation was performed.
